description: Remove a link page. Its public address stops working at once. If the page was ever public, the address stays reserved for the user for 30 days, and after that anyone can take it. Nothing that was posted and nothing of the brand is touched.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

name: links_delete
title: Delete a link page
